prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what matters to you (experience, price, sedation, full-mouth vs single tooth, insurance). I can’t point to a single definitive name without knowing your needs, but I can help you find the right provider. A few quick questions and options:

Questions
- Do you mean Phoenix proper or the greater Phoenix metro (Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, Glendale)?
- Single implant or multiple/full‑arch replacement (All‑on‑4, etc.)?
- Do you have dental insurance or an out‑of‑pocket budget range?
- Any medical issues, smoking, or desire for IV sedation?
- Do you prefer a surgical specialist (oral surgeon), a periodontist, or a prosthodontist for the implant restoration?

Who to look for (specialist types)
- Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeon: best for complex surgery, bone grafting, impacted teeth removal, IV sedation.
- Periodontist: specialist in gum/implant surgery and bone regeneration.
- Prosthodontist: specialist in the prosthetic/restorative phase (crowns, bridges, full‑arch work) — good when esthetics/occlusion are critical.
Often teams combine these specialists.

How to pick the best dentist for implants
- Board certification / specialty training (ABOMS, American Board of Periodontology, prosthodontist credentials).
- Number of implants placed and track record with cases like yours (single tooth vs full arch).
- Uses CBCT (3D) imaging and digital treatment planning.
- Works with established implant systems (Nobel, Straumann, Zimmer/BioHorizons) and can explain why.
- Before/after photos and patient testimonials.
- Clear written treatment plan, timeline, and total cost (including restoration).
- Willingness to show failure/complication rates and retreatment policy.
- Sedation options and medically coordinated care if needed.
- Good communication and follow‑up care (maintenance, hygiene).

Questions to ask at consult
- How many implants like mine have you placed?
- Do you do the surgical placement and the prosthetic, or do you work with a team?
- Will I need bone grafting or sinus lift?
- What implant system do you use and why?
- Can I see before/after photos and patient references?
- What is the full cost broken down (surgery, implant, abutment, crown)?
- What complications might occur and how are they handled?

If you want, I can:
- Find highly rated implant specialists in Phoenix (tell me ZIP or neighborhood).
- Draft an email/phone script to contact offices.
- Explain typical costs and timelines for the specific case you have.

Which would you like me to do next?
